verdict.rationale: Every endpoint page on Mercury's ReadMe-hosted API Reference embeds a live "Try It!" request runner. Each page also has generated code samples in Shell, Node, Ruby, PHP and Python, a Bearer credentials field, per-endpoint parameters and response schemas, and a probe confirms the runner is served live (HTTP 200). A documented sandbox with dummy data supports safe experimentation. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of executing calls via Try It, explicit documentation that the runner can target the sandbox base URL
